text: The caller shall reserve a cap-aligned packet beginning with the contract's 64-byte, sixteen-target-endian-u32 header, magic `0x534d494c`. It shall include signature, fixed/additional counts/table, outcome payload locations/tag, callee identity, caller frame, saved software top, and optional software continuation; reserved fields shall be zero. Exact field offsets shall require the shared contract.
